lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly in cold water.
My heavy head plate presses the current.
My body moves like sunken timber.
I glide along the sea floor.
My fins paddle steadily at my sides.
In cold water my motions are slow.
I round a reef rock.

lines.zh: 深海里没有光，我不需要
lines.en: No light in the deep. I don't need it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，就滑出很远
lines.en: One tail beat carries me far.
My gill covers open and close.
I push forward just above the sand.

lines.zh: 水压在我背甲上，习惯了
lines.en: Pressure on my back plate. I'm used to it.
I rise a little, then sink.

lines.zh: 我在找水里的一点动静
lines.en: I'm hunting a trace of movement.
The water above me is grey.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向更深的地方
lines.en: I turn slowly toward deeper water.
I hang in the water, barely moving.
My jaw plates are heavy.
The cold slows me down.
A shallow trail in the sand.

lines.zh: 我在听水里很远的声音
lines.en: I listen to sounds far through the water.
Old scars on my armour.
I open my jaws, then close them.
The deep's silence presses on the ears.
My armour is heavy; I hang in the cold water.
Something above casts a shadow.
Along the cold seabed I glide.
This body is heavy and rises slowly.

lines.zh: 远处的鱼受伤了，我闻到了。
lines.en: A fish is wounded far off; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我的颚骨动了动，又合上。
lines.en: My jaw plates shift and close again.
I look up. You're past the surface.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，看得很清
lines.en: My eyes are small but sharp.

lines.zh: 你下水了，这就不一样了
lines.en: You've entered the water. That changes things.

lines.zh: 我的头甲冲着你的方向
lines.en: My head plate faces you.

lines.zh: 你在深水里，动作会变慢
lines.en: In deep water your movements slow.
One tail beat brings me closer.
You smell of iron and blood.
My jaws open, then close.
This is my depth.
Either you go up, or you stay.
A new gouge in my plate.
The water churns suddenly.
I veer and steady with my tail.
A scale has come off.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我颌骨发麻
lines.en: The blow numbs my jaw plates.
I sink a little, then rise.
My gill covers flutter faster.
Blood threads through the water.
I know you've hurt me.
But you're still in my water.
That smell isn't food.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔下来，我就看
lines.en: Drop it in and I'll look.
I eat little in cold water.
That won't sink.
You hold it up; I watch from below.
I open my jaws. Not interested.
Try something alive instead.

lines.zh: 我的颌是为了别的长成的
lines.en: My jaws grew for other things.
Reaching down here is dangerous.

lines.zh: 往深处沉一点，水压就对了。
lines.en: Sink a bit deeper and the pressure's right.
You hit my head plate. It's hard.

lines.zh: 我的身子几乎没有后退
lines.en: I hardly give any ground.
The water scatters around the impact.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，从你旁边过去
lines.en: I turn broadside and pass you.
Your feet slip in the water.
That knock turns me off course.
I fan my tail to steady.
Don't push at my gills.
We collide and the water clouds.
I back off and realign.
We rarely meet in the deep.
Swimming a stretch together isn't bad.
My armour is thick. Yours isn't.
Stay at my flank; the current's weaker.
We're both slow. That suits.
This body can't rise anymore.
But it can sink to the bottom with you.
Be quiet and listen to the water.
In cold water, we move slowly.

lines.zh: 有你在，这段深度不算空
lines.en: With you here, this depth isn't empty.
I take it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 沉到沙底的东西，我找得到
lines.en: I can find what sinks to the sand.
Too light. I barely feel it.
I bite once. Hard.

lines.zh: 它从我的颌缝漏下去了
lines.en: It slips between my jaw plates.
I press it into the sand.
Whatever falls in the water is mine.
Not edible. I let it go.
Too heavy — I drag it in my teeth.

lines.zh: 沙底还有别的，我翻一翻
lines.en: More on the sandbed. I'll sift it.
The water moved. It's you.
I turn, head plate aimed at you.
In deep water you have no advantage.
My jaws can shear through shell.
You're sinking. I'll meet you.
I know these waters well.
I won't chase into the shallows.
But you're still at my depth.
Two tail beats and I accelerate.

lines.zh: 你听得见水里的声音吗
lines.en: Can you hear that in the water?
That's my jaw plates grinding.

lines.zh: 张嘴之前，我不会提醒你
lines.en: I won't warn you before I open up.
I approach from below.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里摆得很慢
lines.en: Your legs kick slowly down here.
I circle all the way around you.
In the deep my shadow is faint.

lines.zh: 你往上看，我可能在你后面
lines.en: Look up, and I may be behind you.
My plate will stop your blade.

lines.zh: 水流会先把我的味道送来
lines.en: The current brings my scent first.
You can't hold your breath long.

lines.zh: 我很有耐心，水里更耐心
lines.en: I'm patient. More so in water.
A little deeper still.
My jaws are open as wide as they go.
Now. Jaws open wide.
This bite is for your middle.
My jaws close like a shear blade.
My head plate rams your chest.
The water clouds and you can't see.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你的护腿上
lines.en: This bite clamps your leg guard.
A tail sweep throws you off.
My plate is slick; your blade slides.
Retreat, and the water drags at you.
My weight presses from below.

lines.zh: 咬合的声音在水里很闷
lines.en: The bite sounds muffled underwater.
A tooth print is left on your armour.
I pull back half a length and charge.
In the deep I'm the calmer one.
I rise slightly from the deep.

lines.zh: 冷水里有了一个大影子
lines.en: A large shadow enters the cold water.

lines.zh: 我的甲片反着微弱的光
lines.en: My plates catch a faint light.
The deep cold ocean is my home.
Cold water slows my breathing.
I fan my tail to hold position.
The seabed here is flat.
I came up to see what's above.
The fish here have all fled.

lines.zh: 我很少一次见到两只同类
lines.en: I rarely see two of my kind at once.
The water's dark. My eyes suffice.
I'll hold at this depth.
Something moves up there.
I lift my head plate slowly.
Scalding water makes my tail thrash.

lines.zh: 我摔在湿沙上，甲先着地
lines.en: I land on wet sand, plate first.
Too much water presses me down.

lines.zh: 冲击在水里传开，很难受
lines.en: The blast carries through the water.

lines.zh: 箭在水里慢，我还是中了一记
lines.en: Arrows slow in water, but one struck.
That force doesn't disperse in water.
Too hungry even to swing my tail.
Lightning runs through the water.
The water is gone. I fall.
